  "content": "1|import type { OperationalState } from './operationalState';
2|import type { TaskContract } from './taskContract';
3|
4|/**
5| * V5 Phase P01 § 3.3 — `OperationalPolicyEngine`. `validateProposal` (the EDIT-repeat-failure
6| * gate) shipped in P01. `select()` — choosing a recommended `AgentActionClass` from
7| * `TaskContract` + `OperationalState` + evidence/progress signals — was deferred until those
8| * types existed (P02). It now does, so V5 Phase P03 § V5-5 implements `select()` here.
9| *
10| * Scope note (kept honest, not silently expanded): the doc's full `select()` contract also takes
11| * `UncertaintyState`/`RiskState`/`BudgetState`/`RuntimeHealth` as first-class inputs. This phase's
12| * `select()` only uses the subset of those concepts that's mechanically derivable from real state
13| * today (`OperationalState.failureSignatures` as a risk/uncertainty proxy, `governanceDepth` as
14| * `RiskState`'s concrete P03 slice — see below) — not full uncertainty quantification, which
15| * needs live-model confidence signals this environment cannot produce (EV-3).
16| */
17|export type AgentActionClass =
18|  | 'CLARIFY'
19|  | 'REPRODUCE'
20|  | 'EXPLORE'
21|  | 'LOCALIZE'
22|  | 'INSPECT'
23|  | 'PLAN'
24|  | 'EDIT'
25|  | 'VERIFY'
26|  | 'REVIEW'
27|  | 'RECOVER'
28|  | 'COMPACT'
29|  | 'ESCALATE'
30|  | 'ABSTAIN'
31|  | 'COMPLETE';
32|
33|const READ_TOOL_NAMES = new Set([
34|  'read_file', 'search_codebase', 'list_dir', 'glob_files', 'get_feature_graph',
35|  'get_page_context', 'get_server_function', 'list_server_functions', 'list_packages',
36|  'get_package_manifest', 'list_data_sources', 'describe_schema', 'query_readonly',
37|  'list_jobs', 'get_job', 'list_cache_keys', 'get_cache_entry', 'read_memory',
38|  'list_openapi_routes', 'get_openapi_spec', 'git_status', 'git_diff', 'git_log',
39|  'git_show', 'git_blame',
40|]);
41|
42|/** Real, reachable-today classification — every tool name in the current registry maps somewhere. */
43|export const classifyToolCallActionClass = (toolName: string): AgentActionClass => {
44|  if (toolName === 'ask_clarifying_question') return 'CLARIFY';
45|  if (toolName === 'get_project_standards') return 'INSPECT';
46|  if (toolName === 'run_tests' || toolName === 'test_server_function') return 'VERIFY';
47|  if (toolName.startsWith('draft_')) return 'EDIT';
48|  if (toolName === 'update_todo_list') return 'PLAN';
49|  if (READ_TOOL_NAMES.has(toolName)) return 'EXPLORE';
50|  if (toolName.startsWith('git_commit') || toolName.startsWith('git_checkout') || toolName.startsWith('git_branch')) return 'EDIT';
51|  return 'EXPLORE';
52|};
53|
54|export type ProposedAgentAction = {
55|  toolName: string;
56|  actionClass: AgentActionClass;
57|  /** Normalized mutation target — path, functionId, or 'default' — used for failure-signature matching. */
58|  target: string;
59|};
60|
61|/**
62| * V5 Phase P09 § V5-13 — tool idempotency, from the phase doc's `AgentToolOperationalMetadata`
63| * contract (§14). Coarse, tool-name-level classification (mirrors `classifyToolCallActionClass`'s
64| * own precedent of not needing per-argument granularity to be real and enforceable):
65| *
66| * - `SAFE_RETRY` — read-only/no-mutation tools. Re-issuing after an unknown outcome is harmless.
67| * - `RETRY_WITH_CHECK` — mutates, but the mutation itself is a verifiable/re-checkable action
68| *   (VERIFY-class tools re-run cleanly; git write tools only ever create a *draft* requiring a
69| *   separate human-approval step — confirmed by direct inspection of `gitWriteTools.ts` — so a
70| *   second draft is inspectable/discardable before it does anything, not a blind duplicate mutation).
71| * - `NOT_SAFE` — mutates a real target with no re-check step before the mutation lands
72| *   (`draft_*` builder/patch tools apply directly; `http_request` may have non-idempotent external
73| *   side effects the runtime cannot verify). Must not be blindly retried after an unknown outcome.
74| */
75|export type AgentToolIdempotency = 'SAFE_RETRY' | 'RETRY_WITH_CHECK' | 'NOT_SAFE';
76|
77|const HTTP_REQUEST_TOOL_NAME = 'http_request';
78|
79|export const resolveToolIdempotency = (toolName: string): AgentToolIdempotency => {
80|  if (toolName === 'run_tests' || toolName === 'test_server_function') return 'RETRY_WITH_CHECK';
81|  if (toolName.startsWith('git_commit') || toolName.startsWith('git_checkout') || toolName.startsWith('git_branch')) return 'RETRY_WITH_CHECK';
82|  // Phase doc §14's own worked example classifies draft_file_patch as RETRY_WITH_CHECK, not
83|  // NOT_SAFE: re-issuing is fine as long as it's preceded by a check (e.g. read_file) — the
84|  // runtime can inspect current file state before deciding to retry, unlike an external side
85|  // effect it cannot re-verify. See `DefaultOperationalPolicyEngine.validateProposal`'s
86|  // `pendingUnknownOutcomes` gate below, which blocks blind retry for BOTH NOT_SAFE and
87|  // RETRY_WITH_CHECK — the distinction is what recovery looks like, not whether a gate applies.
88|  if (toolName.startsWith('draft_')) return 'RETRY_WITH_CHECK';
89|  if (toolName === HTTP_REQUEST_TOOL_NAME) return 'NOT_SAFE';
90|  return classifyToolCallActionClass(toolName) === 'EDIT' ? 'NOT_SAFE' : 'SAFE_RETRY';
91|};
92|
93|export type ActionValidation =
94|  | { allowed: true }
95|  | { allowed: false; reasonCode: string; reason: string };
96|
97|/**
98| * V5 Phase P03 § "Grounding — T7 Governance depth dial (p-60)" — turns the pre-existing, purely
99| * internal Path A routing decision (lean/bounded agent-loop vs. heavy governed pipeline — see
100| * `decision-log.md` V4-PATCH-0) into an explicit dial, per p-60 T7's own design rules: default
101| * `AUTO`, `LEAN` is opt-in, and even `LEAN` auto-escalates to `THOROUGH` on high-risk targets.
102| */
103|export type GovernanceDepth = 'LEAN' | 'AUTO' | 'THOROUGH';
104|export type MutationRiskLevel = 'LOW' | 'HIGH';
105|
106|const HIGH_RISK_TARGET_PATTERN = /schema|migration|prisma|\.env(\.|$)|settings\.json|permission|role|auth/i;
107|
108|/**
109| * Real, mechanical risk classification from the mutation target path/functionId — not a live-model
110| * judgment (EV-3 unavailable). Deliberately conservative pattern list: false positives (flagging a
111| * benign file as HIGH) only make governance stricter, never bypass it — false negatives are the
112| * unsafe direction, so the pattern favors recall over precision.
113| */
114|export const classifyMutationRisk = (target: string): MutationRiskLevel => (
115|  HIGH_RISK_TARGET_PATTERN.test(target) ? 'HIGH' : 'LOW'
116|);
117|
118|/** p-60 T7 rule: LEAN is never allowed to silently skip governance on a HIGH-risk target. */
119|export const resolveGovernanceDepth = (
120|  requested: GovernanceDepth,"
}
